seo.title: Separate image elements online for free | Alfora
seo.description: Separate and cut out image elements online for free. Select with points or draw the outline, refine the selection and download the isolated object or the full image with a transparent cutout.

info.title: How to separate an element with Alfora
info.description: Manually select an element using points or freehand tracing, refine the outline and generate two results: the isolated transparent element and the full image with the selected area removed.
info.stepOneText: Select a PNG, JPG or WebP image.
info.stepTwoText: Place points or draw around the element and refine the selection when needed.
info.stepThreeText: Download the isolated element or the full image with the selected area transparent.
